Manage source credential profiles in ~/.drt/profiles.yml.

## Usage

```bash
drt profile [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`add`](profile-add.md) | Interactively add a profile to ~/.drt/profiles.yml. |
| [`list`](profile-list.md) | List all profiles in ~/.drt/profiles.yml (name + source type). |
| [`remove`](profile-remove.md) | Delete a profile entry from ~/.drt/profiles.yml. |
| [`show`](profile-show.md) | Print a profile with any inline secret values masked. |
| [`test`](profile-test.md) | Verify connectivity for a profile (runs the source's connection check). |
